title: InteractionList Overview Tour
description: Browse and manage all interaction records across the organization. Central hub for viewing meetings, calls, emails, and other communications with comprehensive search and filtering capabilities.

popover.title: Welcome to InteractionListComponent
popover.description: This page serves as the central hub for viewing, searching, and managing all interaction records within the organization. Users can browse a comprehensive list of meetings, calls, emails, and other communications, with robust tools for finding specific records and initiating new interactions.

popover.title: New Interaction
popover.description:
Opens a modal window to create and record a new interaction, such as a meeting, call, or email. This allows users to log new communications with partners or contacts.

When to use: When you need to record a new communication, meeting, or activity with partners or contacts., After completing a call or meeting and you want to log the details.

popover.title: Import Interactions
popover.description:
Opens a dialog to bulk import interaction records from external sources, typically Google Sheets or CSV files. This is useful for migrating data or adding many records at once.

When to use: When you need to add multiple interaction records at once from external sources or during a data migration., If you have a spreadsheet of past interactions that need to be added to the system.

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of InteractionList. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
